description: Test script for Employee Onboarding process in ERPNext, including setup, test case, and helper functions for creating related documents.

classes.name: TestEmployeeOnboarding
classes.description: Unit test case for Employee Onboarding process, including setup, test, and teardown.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment by deleting existing onboarding entries and related project/task data.

methods.name: test_employee_onboarding_incomplete_task
methods.description: Tests the onboarding process, including task completion, employee creation, and status checks.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test data by canceling and deleting onboarding documents.

methods.name: get_job_applicant
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Job Applicant document for testing.

methods.name: get_job_offer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Job Offer for a given applicant.

methods.name: create_employee_onboarding
methods.description: Creates and submits a new Employee Onboarding document with associated applicant and offer.
